content:
A 23-year-old Laredo woman was arrested after police say she dragged her friend with her car and crashed into a concrete median barrier on Bob Bullock Loop early Sunday morning, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

Anahi Garcia, 23, of Laredo, was driving around 2:41 a.m. on Nov. 16, 2026, on Bob Bullock Loop near Sinatra Parkway when her 24-year-old friend got out of the car, according to the Laredo Police Department. Police say the friend tried to hold on to the car and was dragged a few meters before Garcia lost control and struck the median barrier.

Police say Garcia admitted she had been drinking and driving. She was charged with driving while intoxicated, possession of a controlled substance in Penalty Group 2 under 1 gram, and possession of marijuana under 2 ounces, according to the report.

Her bonds totaled $9,000, and she was released from the Webb County Jail the next day, according to jail records cited in the report. The friend's injury status was not released.

Source: Laredo Morning Times, Nov. 17, 2026.
